data.cleaned_text: 🇨🇳 China is jamming Starlink over the South China Sea The Philippine side stated that in the area of the disputed Scarborough Reef (Chinese name Huangyan), China has started interfering not only with ships but also with Manila's patrol aircraft. The events of February 18-19 showed that the problem is widespread. Starlink systems on board aircraft, which carried out three patrol flights in the area of the reef, were affected. When approaching, a notification appeared on the aircraft's instruments that the Starlink service is "unavailable in this country". The connection was restored only after the aircraft had moved 13, 15 and 17 nautical miles respectively away from the specified area. These cases indicate systematic actions on the part of the PRC. In fact, it may not just be about jamming the signal, but about creating a so-called "geofence", in which the Huangyan Island area is designated as Chinese territory, which automatically activates a message about the impossibility of providing the service. It is known that the Chinese government has not issued licenses to SpaceX to operate Starlink on its territory, citing national security considerations and the requirement to route internet traffic through state-controlled gateways. The Philippines was particularly alarmed by the dynamics of the Starlink signal's appearance at different distances from the reef. This could mean: · adjustment of the parameters of the restricted zone; · testing and calibration of the system; · gradual expansion of the blocking radius; · demonstrative consolidation of claims to the disputed area. The radius is not static - it changes, indicating active management of the process. What is happening demonstrates a new trend: the struggle for territory is increasingly being transferred to the sphere of technology and information infrastructure. Control over communication, navigation and data transmission is becoming a strategic tool. Blocking the internet signal during maritime monitoring flights has several consequences for Manila: · reduction of situational awareness; · restriction of real-time data transmission; · complicating the coordination of actions; · increasing security risks. china3army

On this day, 40 years ago, the Filipino people showed to the world the power of true unity. Today we commemorate the bloodless toppling of the 20-year dictatorship of Ferdinand Marcos.

Even if the son and namesake is now the President, I refuse to believe that the spirit of EDSA is lost. Its fire may have been reduced to a small flame or embers, especially after the impunity of the Duterte administration which tore the fabric of the nation. But it remains; silent but enduring within our hearts. It is the task of our generation of Filipinos to tend to the flame so that it will be strong again to chase away the darkness that has engulfed our nation. History has its eyes on us. 

Paalabin ang apoy at diwa ng EDSA sa ating mga puso. Lagi't lagi, para sa Bayan.

#NeverForget #NeverAgain
#MarcosMagnanakawHindiBayani
#EDSA40
